projects.fullName: DEVELOPMENT OF A RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTED GENERATION SYSTEM FOR EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS ON ACUTE CORONARY SYNDROME
projects.description: For my thesis developing a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for clinical emergency education, I engineered a comprehensive multimedia pipeline that begins with robust data ingestion using unstructured.io and semantic document vectorization via the intfloat/multilingual-e5-base embedding model. To orchestrate the educational content, I applied targeted prompt engineering to output interactive, JSON-based video learning structures. This architecture seamlessly integrates a suite of state-of-the-art generative models to construct the final interactive learning modules: utilizing Gemini 2.5 Pro for dynamic script generation, Imagen 4 for visual assets, Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS for high-quality audio narration, and Veo 3.1 for video synthesis. Finally, the system's retrieval and generation efficacy was rigorously validated using the Ragas evaluation framework, demonstrating highly relevant outputs with an answer relevancy score of 0.92, alongside a faithfulness score of 0.70 and a context precision of 0.57.
